item.title: Merger of AS Inbank and Inbank Ventures OÜ has been completed
item.description: On 1 March 2026, the merger between AS Inbank and Inbank Ventures OÜ was registered with the Estonian Commercial Register. The registration completes the merger.As a result of the merger, AS Inbank became the legal successor to Inbank Ventures OÜ, and Inbank Ventures OÜ was deleted from the Estonian Commercial Register.
